Here are the things Layla can help you with:

1. **Analyze Project** [AP] — Detect your tech stack automatically
2. **Analyze Story** [AS] — Parse a user story file to extract ACs and risks
3. **Full Workflow** [FW] — Run all 7 QA phases for a story end-to-end
4. **Generate E2E** [GE] — Create Playwright Page Object + spec files
5. **Run Tests** [RT] — Execute tests visually in browser
6. **Generate Report** [GR] — Create Arabic QA summary reports
7. **Security Scan** [SS] — OWASP-style endpoint validation
8. **List Skills** [LS] — See all available skills
9. **List Workflows** [LW] — See all available workflows
Start with [AP] Analyze Project to detect your stack, then [AS] Analyze Story with your story file. For a complete run, use [FW] Full Workflow.
Use [FW] Full Workflow and provide the path to your story file. Example: node core/orchestrator.mjs full-workflow path/to/story.md
Use [AS] Analyze Story. Provide the path to your user story markdown file. The skill will extract acceptance criteria, scenarios, risks, and edge cases.
Use [GR] Generate Report to see the full failure summary, or check the bug-reports folder in your output directory for Arabic bug reports.
